meta.name: walk-the-store
meta.description: Visual walkthrough of the blog — screenshots key pages, builds a browsable gallery. Use when you want to visually inspect the blog, check for regressions after changes, or do a full visual audit. Quick mode screenshots home + current work page. Full mode covers all key pages and components.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 截图博客关键页面并生成可浏览画廊
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在改动后快速检查博客页面是否正常
copy.tagline_en: Screenshot key blog pages and build a browsable gallery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly inspect blog pages after changes

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会对博客进行视觉巡检：截图关键页面，生成可浏览的图库页面，并给出摘要（截图数量、警告、图库链接）。
howto.when: 当你要求检查博客外观、查看改版后的回归问题，或进行完整视觉审计时触发。

say.text: 帮我快速检查一下博客首页和当前工作页。
say.note: 触发默认模式，截图首页和当前分支的修改页。

say.text: 对博客做一次完整视觉审计。
say.note: 触发全量模式，截图所有关键页面和组件。
触发指定页面模式，截图桌面和移动端。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude performs a visual walkthrough of the blog: screenshots key pages, builds a browsable gallery page, and presents a summary (number of shots, warnings, gallery URL).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to visually inspect the blog, check for regressions after changes, or do a full visual audit.

say_en.text: Quick check the blog homepage and current work page.
say_en.note: Triggers default mode: screenshots home and changed pages on current branch.

say_en.text: Run a full visual audit of the blog.
say_en.note: Triggers full mode: screenshots all key pages and components.
Triggers specific page mode: desktop and mobile shots.
